title: Provider and Version Blocks
scenario: The terraform block declares required providers and versions. The provider block configures AWS. Complete the provider block so the region comes from a variable.
constraints: Configure provider aws with region = var.aws_region.
Declare aws_region with a default of us-east-1.

focus.title: Complete the provider block
focus.todo: Set the provider region from the declared variable.

hints.why: Providers tell Terraform which API to call and how to authenticate. Pinning the provider and keeping settings in variables makes a configuration portable and reproducible.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `main.tf`. The work is inside `provider "aws"`. Set the provider region from the declared variable. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Configure a provider once per module and pass credentials through the environment or a secure mechanism, never through committed literals.
hints.how: Open `main.tf` and work only inside `provider "aws"`. Use this code shape: region. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.aws_region`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.

test_manifest.title: provider region comes from a variable
